load_dataset_srn: load an SRN cars dataset with shuffling and batching for JAX training
load_dataset_celeba: load a CelebA-HQ dataset split into train and test subsets with batching
filter_srn_corrupted: filter out SRN scene batches that contain only white background views
process_srn_normalize: normalize SRN image pixel values from 0-255 to 0-1 float range
process_celeba_resize: normalize and resize CelebA-HQ images from 128x128 to 64x64 resolution
